meta.title: Epoch times outside a sane range are refused
gaps: Negative bid_start_time and a value 100 years out are not tested; each requires a fresh draft event because add_rfq_round creates the round only once.
An accepted response with a documented clamp cannot be verified because no documentation or clamped-time assertion field is available.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event with the bid start time 0.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event still has no round (nothing was added).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event still has no round (nothing was added).

plan.title: Epoch times outside a sane range are refused

assert.say: the event still has no round (nothing was added)
